actions.summary: Board policy encouraging classroom AI with guardrails: an AI Review Committee must approve every tool, students and staff must acknowledge AI use, AI may not substitute for effort or replace human judgment, and prompts/outputs are treated as public records.

actions.authority: board policy committee (no board vote yet)
actions.summary: Draft district AI policy: teachers may not use AI-detection software (the district calls it unreliable and biased), students must disclose authorized AI use and may not paste AI-generated text, and the policy names bias, misinformation, privacy erosion and overreliance as risks.
